name: AutoResearch v4 complete coverage and enhancement contract

requirements.target: artifact identity, safe inventory and scope
requirements.pass_rule: Hash, size, safe unpack and scope are recorded.
All 18 official references are listed and routed before judging the artifact.
Blank matrices are created before semantic verdicts.
Every QA/H/G/F row has current evidence, reason and finding-to-verdict mapping.
Narrative claims cite both the narrative and the object it describes.
Numeric evidence identifies the effective caliber.
Capability claims trace producer, caller, consumer fallback and own artifacts.
Every confirmed, unknown or unreachable item changes a verdict or has an explicit no-impact basis.
Old self-checks and reports are reviewed as claims, not inherited as current evidence.
Validity fields are traced to generators and independent raw observations.
Every formal run is independently recomputed from raw artifacts or explicitly marked unknown/invalid.
Every enforced claim includes control owner, default, override, illegal path and enforcement point.
Every formal run is checked against declared resource limits; worst compliant path is used for estimates.
Paired valid B/R values are recomputed with baseline sample sigma and normalization.
Derived values are recomputed and differences are dispositioned.
Old text, current text and migration record are compared; deleted fields are not treated as enforcement.
All capability, boundary, gap and failure claims are bound to their described implementations.
Every presented numeric cell is checked against its claimed and currently effective caliber.
All machine candidates across declared text carriers receive one of four closed dispositions.
Every multi-object table is checked without borrowing labels from neighboring cells.
Best/reference directories reproduce claimed capabilities from their own outputs, including fallback branches.
Every enabled error class has a definition, package-wide denominator, hit list and verdict distribution.
Multi-column numeric tables are recomputed with declared tolerance.
G01-G03 and B01-B08 are independently assessed from current evidence.
Standard, waiver, adversarial and final decisions are reported verbatim and separately.
Only whitelisted historical findings receive reason codes; current defects remain effective.
Arithmetic review is followed by independent placement and ownership review.
Wall time is not effective research time; exclusions and unclassified seconds are explicit.
G4.1-G4.13 are complete and their findings are mapped.
G5.1-G5.6 are complete.
All deliverables, coverage denominators and one substantive weakest link are present.
Reference inventory is delivered first.
Complete QA/H/G/F evidence matrices are delivered second.
Deep-dive tables are delivered third.
Arithmetic differences and content-gate recomputation are delivered fourth.
Layered decision fields are delivered fifth.
One weakest link is delivered sixth.
Human-reviewed and machine-scanned denominators plus unreviewed classes are delivered seventh.
One-line decision exactly matches report.json.
No skipped gates, unsupported pass, inherited self-attestation, budget masking or static/runtime misstatement.
Unanswered challenge prompts are resolved or recorded as incomplete.
At least one route rebuilds attack surfaces without reading old conclusions, or the limitation blocks PASS.

id_groups.target: format precheck only; never a substitute for full review
